title: EXP-094 - Hello World Part 6 Section 2: FX_Orders Form Script Method CalcOrderTotal (Operator-Supplied Tutorial Code), One Designer Save, Readback After Close/Reopen
objective: Follow hello-world-pt6.md Section 2 (01:07-02:05), adapted to FX_ names and User scope: on the FX_Orders Form in the Web Designer, open the Script Editor once, replace its whole content with the exact text of docs/mongoose/scripts/FX_Orders-form-script.vb (the generated EXP-093 template header with class FX_Orders, plus the operator-supplied tutorial method CalcOrderTotal writing FX_DerOrderTotal), read it back verbatim, confirm with OK, and perform exactly one Designer Save. Verify persistence after one Designer close/reopen by opening the Script Editor once more and reading the content back, then restore a clean Designer with one close answering No and one reopen (the EXP-093 dirty-on-open behavior). Then read back the whole editor content verbatim (accessibility tree and screenshot, scrolling the editor view if needed) and compare it line by line with the file. If anything else differs (for example auto-inserted closing brackets or quotes), make at most one correction: Ctrl+A again and re-enter the complete file text once, typing it key by key if the editor auto-completes on fill, then read back again. If it still differs, leave the editor with Cancel, record both texts and stop blocked without Save.

Confirm the editor with OK once. Record any message, compile error or prompt verbatim with a screenshot. If an error appears, acknowledge it once, leave the editor with Cancel if it is still open, record it and stop blocked without Save; the operator decides how to restore the Designer. Never click the editor's Run, Download or Help buttons.

Perform exactly one Designer Save through the native toolbar Save and record its native response verbatim (toast, dialog or error) with a screenshot. If an error appears, record it and stop blocked; never retry the Save.

Persistence: close the clean FX_Orders Designer Form once through its Form-tab control (record any prompt; if a save prompt appears, answer No once and record its text) and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry. Verify Save is disabled. Open the Script Editor once more, read back the whole content verbatim and compare it with docs/mongoose/scripts/FX_Orders-form-script.vb, then leave the editor with Cancel.

Restore clean: if Save is enabled after that Cancel (the EXP-093 behavior), close the FX_Orders Designer Form once with its Form-tab control, answer No once to 'Do you want to save the form definition?' (record the exact text), reopen it once through the recent-forms entry and verify Save, Undo and Regenerate Form disabled. If Save is still enabled, record it and stop blocked.

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate, the editor before the edit, the editor after entry (all lines, scrolling if needed), any OK response, the Save response, the reopened Designer, the editor readback after the reopen, any close prompt before answering, and the final clean Designer.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
